age.evidence: We used 9-16 week-old male homozygous 5-HT2A-R knockout mice (referred as KO2A) and wild-type mice (WT) of the same genetic background (C57/BL6).

sex.evidence: A total of 24 mice (14 WT and 10 KO2A) were implanted... 9-16 week-old male homozygous 5-HT2A-R knockout mice... and wild-type mice (WT)

dosing.evidence: saline + 5-MeO-DMT (5 mg/kg) (SAL + 5-MeO-DMT); All drugs were dissolved in saline (vehicle) and injected subcutaneously (s.c.)

day_night_flipped.evidence: Animals were kept in a controlled environment (12 h light – dark cycle and 22 ± 2 °C room temperature)

judge_notes: All three candidates returned zero scored assays. This is correct: the only behavioural-adjacent procedure in this paper is local field potential (LFP) recording in freely-moving mice, which is a neural electrophysiology measurement explicitly excluded by the rubric ('Neural recordings: ... LFP ... — even if done in awake/behaving animals. These measure NEURAL ACTIVITY, not behaviour.'). No behavioural readouts (locomotion, HTR, freezing, etc.) are reported as primary outcomes.
Consolidated identity fields using modal candidate values; DOI agreed across all three candidates.
